name: VSee
short_description: VSee is a customizable HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with free basic tier and mental health-specific features.
long_description: VSee is a HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform offering video visits, secure messaging, and virtual waiting rooms. The platform provides a free basic tier and scales up for larger organizations. VSee is known for its customizable workflows and is popular among telepsychiatry programs, behavioral health practices, and correctional healthcare facilities. The platform supports e-prescribing integrations and remote patient monitoring, making it suitable for comprehensive virtual care programs.
one_liner: Customizable HIPAA-compliant telehealth with free basic tier.
best_for: Mental health providers needing customizable telehealth workflows
Practices requiring ePrescribe and remote patient monitoring integration
Correctional facilities and healthcare organizations needing secure communication
